task: round 15 scan_hyp_div_sensitivity: public division sensitivity (dc0.30 = -0.005), pre-registration of probes 43/44, next rungs, insertion knobs
summary: The public drop from DeepCenter safe-div 0.25 to 0.30 (0.954 -> 0.949) comes to about 2-3 annotated division TPs lost (90% range 1-4), with about 2 FPs removed. Micro-averaged public div J ~0.35 with D=TP+FP+FN ~44 (90% range 19-72). On public, one division TP is worth about +0.0023 and one FP about -0.0007. The public division term therefore moves in steps of ~0.002 per event, and the lab (6bba D=105, 0-6 TP per 0.05 band) cannot predict it. The leading hypothesis is SHIFT(-0.05): the 44b6-trained center prior scores public daughters ~0.05 lower than 6bba daughters. It explains all three public DC facts: dc0.30 on public behaves like the lab's 0.35 cliff, and the older sjlee-stack forks tie at 0.20 vs 0.25 (0.947/0.947) and lose slightly at 0.15 (0.946). Under SHIFT, probes 44 (0.225) and 43 (0.20) add mostly FPs and display 0.953-0.954. Blended priors: 44 <=0.953 0.40 / 0.954 0.40 / >=0.955 0.20; 43 <=0.953 0.50 / 0.954 0.28 / >=0.955 0.22. The reading table R1-R5 below is pre-registered. Only R1 (43 > 44 >= 0.955) opens exactly ONE more rung: exp70m, DeepCenter 0.175. Never 0.15 or lower, no threshold neighbours, no insertion rungs, no lp30 combos. The insertion knobs stay at 0.4/4. Nothing reaches R8 as a new mechanism.

findings.what: dc0.30 public cost = about 2-3 division TPs. Public score step: ~+0.0023 per TP and ~-0.0007 per FP.
findings.evidence: The metric is micro-averaged: tools/official/src/tracking_cellmot/metrics.py l.474-531, score = adj_edge + 0.1*TP/(TP+FP+FN). A band removal that loses k TP and f FP gives dJ = (TP-k)/(D-f) - TP/D. It hurts iff k/f > J, i.e. band precision > J/(1+J) ~0.26. Displays 0.954 -> 0.949 put the drop in (-0.006,-0.004). Solving, k = 0.05(D-f) + J f. MC conditioned on both displays (scratchpad dcmc3.py; priors G U(10,45), J U(0.28,0.38) per F-MET-08, recall U(0.35,0.6), evaluable forks in [0.25,0.30) Poisson(U(2,10))) gives D 5/50/95% = 19/44/72, TP value 0.0014/0.0023/0.0052, FP value 0.0004/0.0007/0.0018, k0 1/3/4 (P(1)=.09, P(2)=.33, P(3)=.37, P(4)=.17), f0 0/2/6, removed-band evaluable precision 0.33/0.60/1.0. Edge side: each lost TP fork also loses one TP edge worth ~4e-5, which is negligible. Node change -12 on the dummies, also negligible.

findings.what: Lesson (post-deadline list): lab-to-public transfer for DIVISION knobs is governed by Poisson event counts. The exp60 6bba bed has D=105 and 0-6 TPs per 0.05 DC band, and public has D ~44. A lab mean of +0.001 (dc0.30) had no predictive power for the sign: one or two events on one embryo flip it. Division knobs need either >= ~20 TP events in the moved band, or a public read as the primary evidence.
